fusions.name: Wire Around the Throat
fusions.desc: Loops a blade-fine strand around a target at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Nicks
fusions.desc: Lashes a fan of fine cutting strands 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tripwire
fusions.desc: Strings a knife-lined wire at the nearest enemy. It waits 10 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 16 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Narrow Miss
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow that would have hit you is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
